title: PaymentIntentRequest
description: JSON-RPC params for creating a payment intent. V1 records the intent as an evy.transactions row with status "intent"; a real Stripe PaymentIntent will be created later. Server-side constants (not request params): confirm=true, capture_method="manual" (authorized at creation, captured later by the seller), payment_provider="stripe", fees 0, signature="signed".

fk.description: The marketplace item this payment intent covers (→ Stripe metadata later).

resource.description: Resource ref of the record `fk` belongs to, e.g. marketplace.items.

currency.description: From the item's price; "AUD" in v1.

authorization_message_id.description: The buyer's original request message (the message stating the price).
